items.quote: Instead of pitching features, use their exact words back to them.
items.statement: Use clients' exact words back to them in presentations.

items.quote: most agents think selling means talking. But the real skill is listening.
items.statement: The skill of selling lies in listening rather than talking.

items.quote: When clients tell you they dream of waking up to sea views, having breakfast on a balcony, or being close to their kids' school - write it down.
items.statement: Write down clients' dreams and priorities during discussions.

items.quote: When you use their language, their priorities, their emotional triggers - resistance disappears.
items.statement: Using clients' language reduces sales resistance.

items.quote: People trust themselves more than they trust you.
items.statement: Clients trust themselves more than they trust agents.

items.quote: Help them convince themselves of what THEY already told you they want.
items.statement: Help clients convince themselves rather than trying to persuade them.

overview: LinkedIn post about sales techniques for agents to engage clients.
